title: aspidium pallidum
intro: Aspidium pallidum, commonly known as the Aspidium fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium pallidum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its potential in treating infections and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Aspidium pallidum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
